title: Israeli army continues Hebron siege for second day, arrests 19 Palestinians; UN voices deep concern
detail: The Israeli army kept Hebron under siege for a second day as it launched a new military operation in the occupied West Bank, arresting 19 Palestinians. The UN voiced deep concern over escalating violence.

media.caption: Israel launches new military operation in the occupied West Bank

title: Israel removes 250 Palestinian families from Hebron after deadly attack
detail: Israeli authorities removed about 250 Palestinian families from Hebron following a deadly attack, per a news aggregator headline. Details are unconfirmed pending a primary report; this occurs amid the ongoing Hebron siege and new West Bank operation.
